turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello—what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what’s been going on? Patient: I’m a 44-year-old man, and I’ve had small, non-itchy bumps on my left thigh for about three weeks. I’ve also been feeling fatigued and generally unwell for a few months.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling in your joints?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t noticed any joint swelling. I haven’t had any significant aches or pains in my joints, just the general fatigue and feeling unwell.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual growths on your scalp?
turns.patient_answer: I haven’t noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual growths on my scalp. The only changes I’ve seen are the small, non-itchy bumps on my left thigh.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or a sensation of itchiness lately?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t had any itching or a sensation of itchiness—those bumps on my left thigh are not itchy.

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble lifting your arms above your head?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t had any trouble lifting my arms above my head. I can move normally, aside from feeling generally fatigued and unwell for the past few months.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any loss of vision that isn’t accompanied by pain?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any loss of vision or any change in my vision at all.

turns.doctor_question: Have you had a fever that’s been so high it feels like you’re burning up—something above 104°F (40°C) that makes you feel extremely hot or dizzy?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any fever like that—I don’t feel extremely hot or dizzy, and I haven’t had any burning-up episodes.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling unusually stressed or overwhelmed lately?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: I haven’t felt unusually stressed or overwhelmed, but I’ve been having this ongoing fatigue and malaise for a few months, and the non-itchy bumps on my left thigh for about three weeks. I don’t really know what could’ve triggered it.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any burning or discomfort when you urinate?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any burning or discomfort when I urinate. I haven’t noticed any urinary changes at all, just the fatigue and the non-itchy bumps on my left thigh.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling chills or a sudden cold sensation lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had chills or any sudden cold sensations. It’s mostly been that ongoing fatigue and malaise, along with the small non-itchy bumps on my left thigh for the past three weeks.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breast that feel fixed and don’t move when you touch them?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lumps or masses in my breast area. I haven’t felt anything fixed or non-moving when I touch.”
